title: Sound Effect Lab staging and anime SFX pack
description: A set of 17 effects for staging and anime-style cuts: scene changes, emphasis cuts (a shine, a slide, a pop), comic retorts, clumsy reactions, and sparkle accents. (Count: 17) [2026-08-23] The SFX review added Doon, a heavy impact and the successor of the old sfx-impact-echo.
when_to_use: When you want an accent on a scene change, the start of an emphasis cut, a comic retort or reaction, or a sparkle
